date_scope_check.qualification_retained: H19-D1: The April 13 endpoint is limited Egyptian return facilitation at Arqin, with instructions effective that morning and reported arrivals of buses carrying citizens and students. It does not establish reopening for all passenger classes or Sudan’s whole frontier. Exact onset and first-passage hours remain unknown. The separate 24-hour airspace restriction is not used for land duration.
